prior_launcher_attempt.description: A preliminary measurement wrapper attempt exited 127 because /usr/bin/time was unavailable; timeout/Python census was not launched in that attempt. It is separate from the subsequent successful census command.

record_type: capture erratum; all original raw files preserved
stderr_discrepancy: The script entrypoint catches BaseException around raise SystemExit(main()), so SystemExit(0) is printed as a misleading FAIL diagnostic after main wrote a PASS result and returned 0. The captured timeout command exit is 0; census.json status is PASS. No result or raw log was edited. This is a harness diagnostic defect, not a census acceptance failure.
